_comment: Reachability and target of knockdown store 0x8004AFB0. Regenerate: tools/phase4_knockdown_reachability.py
verdict: REACHABLE. The chain is only self-contradictory along the path where player+0x84 == 1; the branch at 0x8004AEBC takes the other path, which bypasses the actor+0x6C := 10 write and leaves actor+0x5E free to be non-zero.

structural_checks.CORRECTION_fp_base: An earlier revision called fp a runtime object pointer and treated this as a possible power-slot clear. The image pins v1=0x800A6500 and fp=v1+4, so the store always lands at player+0x82.

guards.note: beq -> 0x8004B0C4 when clear; bit 0x20 of the actor flag word must be SET
bne -> 0x8004B67C when set; bit 0x40 must be CLEAR

THE DECIDING BRANCH. bne v1,1 -> 0x8004AEFC takes the path that BYPASSES the actor+0x6C := 10 write. When player+0x84 == 1 the fall-through path writes actor+0x6C := 10 (if actor+0x5E != 0) and 0x8004AF04 then diverts, making the clear unreachable. This is the guard the earlier probe never controlled.
bne -> 0x8004B67C; must be zero on entry, which the bypass preserves
slt/beq -> 0x8004B054; a positional test between the player and the actor
bltz -> 0x8004AFC0; player vertical velocity must not be negative (not rising)
beq -> 0x8004AFBC; the player must already be in an action-locked state
beq -> 0x8004AFBC; combined with 0x8004AEBC this pins player+0x84 to a value that is neither 1 nor 17

effects.effect: player+0x82 := 0       (jal delay slot; NOT the power slot)

why_earlier_probes_missed_it: The earlier attempt poked player+0x7C := 17 to satisfy 0x8004AF5C, but never controlled player+0x84, which 0x8004AEBC tests against 1. It also never controlled the actor-side fields (0x5C bits, 0x5E, 0x6C). With player+0x84 == 1 the clear is genuinely unreachable, so the probe was measuring the wrong path and the zero-event execTrace was consistent with that.
runtime_confirmation: Historical oracle: at a known contact, set player+0x84 to a value that is neither 1 nor 17, player+0x7C non-zero, player+0x2C >= 0, player+0x9F == 0, actor+0x5E non-zero, actor+0x6C == 0, actor+0x5C with bit 0x20 set and bit 0x40 clear; then watch 0x8004AFB0 for execution and confirm there is NO write to the slot. Confirm player+0x2C == -1536 and player+0x7C == 5 afterwards, which distinguishes a real knockdown from an incidental event.
